sources.scope_read: Theorem1.1 and proof; already read previously. Filename is a local label, not the document date.

conclusion: Known original-point kernels, integer parity, classical planar envelopes and Fu recover the same stated leading bound and bit stability. This does not prove that the combined TV formula was previously published; the substantial-own-advance claim is downgraded.
benchmarks: V25 and V28 unchanged; no new thresholds, examples or measurements introduced.
